svg.aria-label: Every FSL check ends in exactly one outcome with its own exit code: success 0; violation or undefined 10; indeterminate 11; refused 20; unsupported 21; incomplete or inconclusive 22; internal failure 30; a clause still pending when its trace ends exits 0. Only success and violation are answers about the rule; the others say why no answer was given.
